messages.content: I arrive at Crownspire Academy to register for the Vanguard department.
Imperial Year 731, Day 1, 08:00. You are in the registration hall. Lyra Fen is waiting by the notice board. You carry one practice sword, one uniform, and twenty crowns.
Note for the narrator only: I carry a letter whose author is unknown to Lyra. Keep its contents private.
The registration clerk will return at 08:15. Your registration is still pending.
